subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving completed bookings for your accommodation platform. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the completed booking read back after the free-cancellation window closes, so the volume you pay for is reserved and paid stays, with cancelled and fraudulent bookings rejected before billing. At scale that runs around 2,100 completed bookings a day (illustrative) on validated room nights. If it helps, I can pull the destination-level booking and post-cancellation read for you. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate completed-booking + cancellation-window proof
illustrative_flags: 2,100 completed bookings a day (MobUpps-specific daily completed-booking volume; illustrative placeholder; never an established MobUpps result)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN travel_and_booking/OTA: references prior outreach in opening sentence; restates single proof (completed-booking optimization read after the free-cancellation window, fraud/cancellation rejected pre-billing); one illustrative MobUpps figure (2,100 completed bookings/day); soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native English; no em dash; no 'X, not Y' (positive specification stated directly); brands only from candidate list (none named here).
